name: Shammuah
overview: The name Shammuah appears in Scripture as one of the sons of King David born in Jerusalem, with variations of the name including Shimea, Shammua, and Shimea. The passages in 2 Samuel 5:14 and 1 Chronicles 3:5 and 14:4 consistently list Shammuah among David's children alongside Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon. These verses emphasize the historical and genealogical significance of Shammuah within David's family line, highlighting the providence of God in the lineage through which Christ would ultimately come.
